div.head: V As 1.1
div.ab: Gif se hlaford þonne wille ðone man mid woh fordon, berecce hine þonne, gif he mage, on folcgemote; ⁊ gif he laþleas beo, sece swylcne halford on þa gewitnesse swylcne he wille; forðy þe ic an, ðæt ælc ðara þe laþleas beo, folgie swilcum hlaforde swylcum he wille.

If, however, the lord wrongfully intends to ruin the man, he [the man] shall clear himself, if he can, in a public meeting. If he proves himself free from crime, he may seek, with the witness of those present, any lord he wishes; for I give permission to everyone who is free from crime to serve any lord he may wish.

Gif se hlaford ðonne wille ðone mon mid woh fordón, berecce hine ðonne, gif he mæge, on folcgemote; gif he laþleas sy, sæte hwylcne halforde on þa gewitnysse swylcne he þonne wille; forþon ic wille, þæt ylc þæra þe laþleas beo, folgige swylcum hlaforde swylce he ðonne wylle.
